inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow add-back (RMB2.336m); no net-share-settlement tax line (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year). H1-2026 SBC RMB0.42m.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1724, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16 22:01Z. Direction check: the H1-2026 interim dividend was declared at RMB0.1309 = HK$0.1513 using the PBoC 27-Aug-2026 rate of HK$1.1556 per RMB1.00, i.e. HKD per CNY > 1, same direction and within 1.5% of the Yahoo rate. No A-share or ADR dual listing for a price parity check. All flows and the bridge are in CNY millions; per-share values are converted to HKD at this rate.
inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average shares H1-2026 (738,697,300 basic + 652,671 restricted-share dilution = 739,349,971), 2026 interim report note 8. Held FLAT: SBC (~0.1-0.4% of revenue) is expensed in the flows and there is no non-SBC issuance. No buybacks since FY2023 (RMB0.68m) -- the flat count is a modelling convention, not a funded one, but SBC is immaterial.
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY-built cost of equity: China 10y CGB ~1.9% + ~7.0pp equity risk premium for an HK-listed PRC small cap with beta ~1.0, plus ~1pp for VIE/healthcare-advertising regulatory structure = ~10%. No borrowings, so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in all scenarios: risk is carried in the flows (scenario paths and a 25% bear weight), not stacked in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease principal + interest (FY2025 RMB11.3m + 0.55m; H1-2026 RMB3.7m + 0.3m, ~1.2-1.8% of revenue) charged via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB6.4m at 30-Jun-2026) excluded from net debt. da_pct_path is set ex right-of-use depreciation.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI charged once, in the bridge: FY2025 NCI profit RMB13.5m (H1-2026 RMB6.3m), deducted at ~10x annualised NCI profit = RMB125m (book NCI RMB54.4m). Flows are consolidated (EBITDA is group-level).
inputs.non_operating_assets: Investable cash and near-cash at 30-Jun-2026 (CNY m): cash & equivalents 1,586.3 + non-current time deposits 10.2 + debt investments 2,535.8 (1,812.2 non-current + 723.6 current; bonds and wealth-management products the company OWNS) + FVTPL financial assets 352.3 = 4,484.6. Held at book in `cash`. Interest and investment income on this pile (FY2025 RMB177.6m interest; ~RMB193.5m other income and gains) is NOT in the flows: interest received is classified in investing cash flow, so OCF/FCF already exclude it and nothing is subtracted a second time; the operating EBITDA used here (RMB188.4m FY2025) is operating profit before other income. The income is valued through its matching asset, once.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF (component route) + non-US adaptations. Medlive is an operating company -- a physician-facing medical information platform (medlive.cn) monetised mainly through digital precision marketing sold to pharma and device makers (~94% of H1-2026 revenue), plus medical knowledge and patient-management solutions. No deposits, no balance-sheet lending, no property: the routing table sends it to owner-FCF, with the adaptations for CNY-reporting/HKD-quote, NCI, leases and the large non-operating investment portfolio. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry). The defining feature is the balance sheet: investable cash/near-cash of CNY4.48bn (HK$5.26bn) exceeds the HK$4.82bn market cap, so the market assigns a negative value to an operating business earning ~RMB170m+ of operating EBIT. Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 121.7 (OCF 134.5 - capex 12.8) - SBC 2.3 - lease cash 11.9 = RMB107.5m; interest income not deducted because it was never in OCF. FY2025 cash conversion was depressed by working capital (OCF 134.5 vs EBITDA less cash tax 176.2); 3-year average conversion is ~96%. Interim dividend RMB0.1309/sh (RMB96.8m) went ex in Sep-2026 and was paid ~6-Oct-2026, after the balance-sheet date -- deducted in equity_bridge because today's price is ex-dividend. Contingent consideration payable (RMB26.5m) is debt-like and deducted.
inputs.dividend_note: Dividends paid FY2025 RMB185.6m against attributable NPAT RMB334.3m (~55% payout, effectively the interest income being passed through). Dividends are not separately added -- they are distributions of the flows and cash already valued.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case 10-year average revenue growth. Equity CAGR is not usable (book is ~90% IPO cash, growth is capped by a ~55% payout); historical revenue/EPS CAGRs are not usable either because growth collapsed to +1% YoY in H1-2026.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (3.4-5.3%) diverges >30% from revenue (22.6-26.9%) and EPS (41.9-62.8%) CAGRs. Book value is dominated by the 2021 IPO proceeds and dividends of ~55% of NPAT, so it is not a growth signal; EPS growth is inflated by interest income on IPO cash ramping with rates (FY2021 5.3m -> FY2024 204.7m).
historical_growth.notes: '5yr' columns are the 4-year span FY2021-FY2025 (no FY2020 data). Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC): FY2021 28.2, FY2022 52.5, FY2023 58.9, FY2024 81.8, FY2025 119.4. Owner-FCF CAGR exceeds reported because SBC fell from RMB17.2m (FY2022) to RMB2.3m (FY2025) -- the opposite of the warning case. Revenue growth: FY2023 +31%, FY2024 +36%, FY2025 +15%, H1-2026 +1%.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +3% (H1 +1.0%, H2 assumed modestly better on customer count 191->217 and products 445->509); re-acceleration to high single digits as innovative-drug launches and the shift of pharma promotion budgets from reps to compliant digital academic marketing continue; fade to 3%.
base.margin_rationale: Operating EBITDA (pre other income, post-IFRS16) was 29.3% FY2025 and 33.4% H1-2026 (24.9% H1-2025) on AI-driven delivery-cost cuts (cost of sales -5.5% YoY). Base holds ~34%; no further expansion assumed.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax paid RMB12.2m FY2025 on ~RMB167m operating EBIT = 7.3% (preferential software/HNTE regimes plus offshore entities). Ramped to the 15% HNTE rate by year 8.
base.wc_rationale: Receivables + contract assets consume cash as revenue grows (FY2025 OCF fell ~RMB42m short of EBITDA less tax; contract assets RMB52.9m -> 146.6m in H1-2026). -30% of the revenue change.

scenario_narratives.base: Medical-insurance cost control keeps pharma marketing budgets tight through FY2026 (revenue +3% after H1's +1%), but the structural shift of promotion spend from in-person reps to compliant, auditable digital academic marketing -- the anti-corruption campaign's side effect -- plus a steady flow of innovative-drug launches returns growth to 7-8% in FY2027-29 before fading to 3%. The AI-driven delivery-cost savings of H1-2026 hold, keeping operating EBITDA ~34%. Preferential tax status erodes slowly to 15%. The CNY4.48bn investment portfolio is valued at book and continues to fund a ~55% payout.
scenario_narratives.bull: Medlive's ~6m-physician platform and proprietary medical vertical LLM make it the default compliant channel as pharma budgets migrate online: customer count (217) and products marketed (509) keep rising ~15%/yr, paid-click pricing firms, and revenue re-accelerates to 12% for two years. AI tooling lifts operating EBITDA toward 39%. Management deploys part of the cash pile through buybacks or a special dividend, closing the discount to cash (not modelled in flows; it shows up as the market re-rating to IV).
scenario_narratives.bear: Volume-based procurement and medical-insurance cost control shrink pharma marketing budgets outright and regulators tighten rules on physician-facing academic promotion and patient education; revenue falls two years running and recovers only to inflation. Price competition from AI answer engines and pharma in-house platforms compresses operating EBITDA to 26%, receivables stretch as customers pay slowly (WC capture -50%), and the HNTE/software tax preferences are lost (cash tax to 25%). The cash pile remains but is valued at book; the bear case does not haircut it for capital misallocation, which is the main residual risk not in the flows.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: revenue stalled to +1% in H1-2026, ~94% of revenue depends on one customer set (PRC pharma/device promotion budgets) under active cost-control and anti-corruption regulation. Base 50% as the central case. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs both a budget recovery and further margin expansion to go right together.

valuation_philosophy.summary: An operating DCF on a net-cash company where the cash is most of the value. The CNY4.48bn of cash, deposits, bonds and wealth-management products (HK$7.1/share at 1.1724) exceeds the share price on its own; the DCF adds the operating business on top, net of NCI, contingent consideration and the dividend already declared. The key question is not the growth path but whether minority holders ever see the cash beyond the ~55% payout -- the market is pricing the operating business below zero.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash accessibility and capital allocation: 68.7% of cash is USD and part is in wealth-management products; a value-destructive acquisition (goodwill already RMB192.5m) or indefinite hoarding would make book value of the portfolio an overstatement of what minority holders receive.
PRC pharma marketing budget cycle: medical-insurance cost control and VBP compressing customer revenue; H1-2026 revenue growth +1%.
Regulatory: anti-corruption and patient-education compliance rules applied to physician-facing academic promotion.
Year-1 owner-FCF margin (~25%) is well above FY2025's 16.7% because FY2025 conversion was depressed by receivables/contract-asset build; if that build is structural, base is overstated.
Tax: operating cash tax ~7% relies on preferential regimes that could lapse.
FX: CNY flows and bridge translated to HKD at 1.1724; ~69% of cash is held in USD, so CNY/USD moves the bridge (H1-2026 OCI loss RMB122m).
